text: Administrative authorisation: I authorise this change to a user account or a system setting.
Approval (release disposition): I have reviewed this record and approve it.
Archive decision: I have verified this archive bundle against its manifest and decide that these records are archived and read-only.

Audit trail review: I have reviewed the audit trail entries in this scope, including every exception listed, and I am satisfied that they are complete and acceptable or that every concern has been raised.
Audit trail review setting: I authorise this change to whether a signed audit trail review is required before batch release.
Authorship: I performed or recorded this work and confirm that it is accurate and complete.
Final batch release disposition: I authorise this batch for release.
Calibration: I performed or witnessed this calibration and confirm that the result is recorded correctly.
Clock anomaly acknowledgement: I have checked the system clock, corrected it where needed, and assessed the records written while it was wrong.
Authorisation of Certificate of Analysis: I have reviewed the certified results against the specification and authorise this certificate for issue.
Withdrawal of Certificate of Analysis: I withdraw this certificate; it must no longer be used or relied on.
Receipt deviation acknowledgement: I have assessed the condition of this sample on receipt and I accept it for testing.
Directory group mapping decision: I have reviewed this directory group to LIMS role mapping and approve or retire it. Members of the group receive the role at their next sign-in.
Document approval: I approve this version of the document for issue.
Document authorship: I wrote this version of the document, it is complete and accurate, and I submit it for review.
Document effectivity: I release this approved version as the effective version; the previous version is superseded and training is assigned.
Document withdrawal: I withdraw this document from use; it becomes obsolete.
Document review: I have reviewed this version of the document for technical accuracy and completeness.
Approval of environmental monitoring limits: I have checked these alert and action limits against their cited source and approve them for judging the results of this site.
Calculation approval: I have reviewed this revision of the calculation and its test cases and approve it for GMP results.
Approval of instrument data mapping: I have reviewed the instrument, the folder, the parser and the column mapping of this profile, and approve it for the capture of results.
Legal hold: I place or release the hold on this record class on the basis stated.
Master data status decision: I have reviewed this product or batch record and authorise the change of its status.
Method approval: I have reviewed this revision of the analytical method and approve it for GMP testing.
Module qualification decision: I have reviewed the qualification evidence of this module and declare whether it is qualified for GxP use.
OOS investigation closure and disposition approval: I confirm that the investigation, the root cause and the conclusion are complete.
Invalidation of an OOS result: I have reviewed the laboratory investigation, I confirm the assignable cause and I invalidate the original result.
Retest authorisation: I authorise the retests of this plan, their justification and their maximum number, before any retest is performed.
OOS workflow setting: I authorise this change to the retest and due-date rules of OOS investigations.
Periodic review: I have reviewed the evidence and the findings of this periodic review and record its conclusion.
Action completion: I performed this action and the evidence referenced is complete and accurate.
Quality approval: I have reviewed this quality record (investigation, action plan or change) and approve it.
Quality closure: I confirm that the actions are complete, verified effective where required, and close this record.
Effectiveness verification: I have checked the evidence against the effectiveness criteria and record the result.
Emergency change authorisation: I authorise this change before the full review because waiting would put product or patients at risk; it must be reviewed retrospectively.
Quality rejection: I have reviewed this quality record and reject or cancel it.
Quality system setting: I authorise this change to how change control is enforced.
Qualification override: I authorise this analyst to perform this method before the required training is complete, for the period and the reason stated.
Material rejection: this lot is rejected and must not be used for any test.
Material release: I have reviewed the receipt record and the certificate of analysis of this lot, and I release it from quarantine for laboratory use.
Material retest: this lot was retested against its specification and remains suitable for use until the new retest date.
Receipt: I received this material and checked it against its certificate and the order.
Reintegration approval: I have reviewed this reprocessing of the raw data against the procedure and approve the reported value.
Rejection (return or quarantine): I have reviewed this record and reject it.
Disposal of a retained sample: I confirm that its retention period has ended and I authorise its disposal.
Retention policy: I set the retention period of this record class on the basis stated.
Control limit baseline approval: I have reviewed the data, the exclusions and the computed limits, and approve them as the reference for trending this attribute.
Master data approval: I approve this specification for use in testing.
Stability protocol approval: I have reviewed this protocol revision (conditions, pull points, pull window and test plan) and I approve it for use.
Review and verification of analytical results: I confirm that the results are accurate and complete and submit them for independent review.
Test plan approval: I have reviewed this revision of the test plan and approve it for use.
Training read and understood: I have read and understood this training material.
Training certification: I confirm that this person has completed and understood the training.
Verification: I independently checked this record against its source and confirm that it is correct.
